profile.summary: A group of trained football officials (referees) that provides high school football officials for schools in Alameda, Contra Costa and Solano counties in the East Bay. It serves leagues including the Oakland Athletic League, and also provides officials for girls' flag football. It holds annual clinics for officials and awards scholarships to student-athletes.
